purpose: Choose solver iteration counts so the PhysX grasp joint stays rigid like the MuJoCo weld (torquescale=1). Measured with authoring/grasp_twist_probe.py on the author host (Isaac 5.1.0.0, RTX 4090, CPU PhysX TGS, dt 0.002) before SOLVER_*_ITERATIONS were added to deposit_coin.py; the probe overrides the counts on every rigid body.
metric: largest rotation of the held coin relative to the gripper while held, degrees

no_wrist.note: coin self-aligned to ~14 deg skew and wedged 10 mm into the lid; on Isaac 6.0.1 / Modal the jaw then released it and it fell in (reward 1, run modal_r1)

reason: 255 is the PhysX maximum position iteration count; it keeps the twist under 0.5 deg when the 200 N gantry drives a held 5 g coin into the lid.
